notes.title: Update 1.6 More settings
notes.content:
Hi,

Since the launch, the settings in Darksy's Adventure have been very limited. You could change some really basic settings but that was about it. Most of the settings present didn't even effect performance that much. 
A great example of that is texture quality. Textures are stored in vram, these days however vram sizes are big and the likelihood of your running out of vram is small. The only setting that really did have any impact were shadows and you could only enable or disable them which led to 2 choices: bad looking game or bad fps. This update changes all of that.

[list]
[*] Added resolution settings. You can select among 3 resolutions: 720p, 1080p and 4K
[/list]

I deem this setting to be the most important as it effects FPS in the most impactful way. If you're running the game on an old laptop with 
integrated graphics, you can turn down all of the settings as much as you want and you'll still end up with 15 FPS because the game has to render
a 1080p image on a 720p screen.

[list]
[*] Added full screen toggle setting
[/list]

This one is just a nice quality of life feature.

[list]
[*] Added more shadows settings. You can select among 5 shadow settings: Full resolution, High resolution, Medium resolution, Low resolution, Disabled
[/list]

This is the second most impactull setting. Shadow calculations are expensive and some weaker hardware cannot cope with them well. Having 5 settings
instead of just an on and off setting will hopefully allow some players to experience shadows with high framerates.
These settings also affect shadow draw distance.

[list]
[*] Added post processing toggle setting
[/list]

Post processing effects add things like ambient occlusion, bloom, depth of field etc.. The game uses post processing but up until now there was no way of disabling it.
Post processing eats up framerate because on top of all the shadow calculations and rendering, the game has to also apply various effects a well.

Bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game wouldn't save mouse sensitivity settings properly
[/list]

Other:

[list]
[*] Made level 6 easier
[*] Improved world 2 boss little bit
[/list]

Until next time!

notes.title: Update 1.5: Boss Improvement and Quality of Life
notes.content:
Hi!

It's been a while since the last update hasn't it? During that time I've been collecting feedback. So let's get into the changes!

[b]Boss 4[/b]

Since the launch of the game, boss 4 has been confusing for many players. Players have reported that they don't know how to beat the boss.

[list]
[*] The boss is now slower when at max health.
[*] Increased the size of the button's hitbox.
[*] When the boss has full health there are arrows pointing at the button.
[/list]

[b]Boss 6[/b]

[list]
[*] When the boss has full health there are arrows pointing at him to show the player that they have to pounce into him.
[/list]

[b]Quality of life[/b]

[list]
[*] Made minigames more easier
[*] The game will now show you which minigames have been completed in the level select
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Darksy's tail whip is now cancelled when colliding with a steep surface. This is here to make it more difficult to climb up walls the player is not supposed to climb.
[*] Fixed typos and grammar mistakes.
[*] Fixed some level skips (Level 18 mainly).
[*] You can no longer shoot atoms while sliding.
[*] Cactuses in the Wild Furry West now deal damage to make the world slightly more difficult. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3: Experimental controller support and boss 1 improvements
notes.content:
Hi, 

Since last update I have received new feedback regarding the game. Here is a list of changes:

[b]Boss 1[/b]

Players have said that the boss fight doesn't make it obvious what they're supposed to do. This issue popped up during development too. 
I tried to fix it with a cutscene but it's now clear that cutscene isn't enough. Before I get into the changes I'd like to discuss how the boss worked.
Looking back at it I do admit that these changes should have been done sooner. General Foxin had a 6 second timer. This timer would tick down if the player were
close enough, if they weren't he would follow them. If the timer reached 0 zero, a rocket would get fired. This led to strange situations where sometimes the player would have to sit there for 6. This must have led
some players into believing that they were doing something wrong. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] General Foxin's timer has been reduced from 6 seconds to 3 seconds.
[*] General Foxin's timer now goes down even if the player is far away.
[*] General Foxin no longer shoots rockets if one has already been shot.
[*] General Foxin's rockets follow timer has been reduced by 1 second across all difficulties.
[*] The brick wall now emits subbtle particles to hopefully guide the players.
[*] The brick wall now has effect for when General Foxin rams into it.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused General Foxin to push you out of bounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes General Foxin's rage would just abruptly stop right after starting
[/list]

[b]Experimental controller support[/b]

Some players have been disappointed with the lack of controller support. Unfortunately during most of the game's development I didn't own any controller meaning I was unable to implement controller support.
Right now I only own a PS1 dualshock. Of course this controller is outdated and the driver support isn't best either. This does allow me to implement controller support half-blindly.

[b]Right now the controller support works fully only during gameplay and not in menus!

If everything has been set up correctly, here are the controls:[/b]

XBOX 360:

[list]
[*] Move - left joystick
[*] Camera Look - right joystick
[*] Jump - X
[*] Shoot Atom - Right bumper
[*] Pounce - Y
[*] Tail whip - A
[*] Use Secret Ability - Left bumper
[*] Use Ability - Left Trigger
[*] Slide - A
[/list]

Please keep in mind that this is still only experimental and might remain like this for a while until I get a more modern controller. 

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a duplicated description for the purple star. (oops)
[/list]

Until next time!

notes.title: Update 1.2: Quality Of Life
notes.content:
Hello,

This update focuses mainly on communicating things to the player best. 

[b]UI Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] The game didn't make it clear what the symbols below the level name on the level select screen meant. To fix this issue I've added a question mark button next to them that tells you what they mean.
[*] 
[*] Selecting a difficulty, you would get told that you couldn't complete the game 100%. This was a bit misleading because what it actually meant was that you can't reach a completion score of 100%. Having known that description I've just mention would still confuse people, I instead chose to tell to the a much more important piece of information. The text now tells the player that any atoms they collect will not be saved.
[*] 
[*] Playing on easy difficulty, the game now shows you on the level end screen that no collected atoms will be saved.
[*] 
[*] Fixed some UI bugs
[/list]

[b]Level 2 changes[/b]

Level 2 has been problematic since launch and new players have struggled with it. The problem is that it is a linear level that seems like a "free roaming" level at first. What first time players do is they usually miss the switch at the beginning near the crashed rocket. This leads them to wondering all over the level, not having known what to do. To [i]hopefully[/i] fix this issue I have made a massive change. Starting the level, it is now split in half by gates. These gates only unlock once the player has activated the aforementioned switch. The idea here is that there is no reason why the player should be on the opposite side of the level at the start when there is nothing for them to do yet so why allow them to go there in the first place? The gates should also give players a more defined goal at the start.

[b]Other[/b]

[list]
[*] Arrows now have particles to make them more stick out.
[*] 
[*] Fixed typos
[/list]

Until next time!

notes.title: What can you expect from Darksys's Adventure?
notes.content:
Hello,
This is Honza 55 44 speaking, while you are eagerly waiting to join Darksy on his adventure I'd like to talk to you more in-depth about the game itself and what you can expect in the game and post launch.
 
[b]Post launch support[/b]

After the game comes out I will be closely monitoring the feedback the game receives and make changes based on it. Most of the post launch updates will only include bug fixes and slight tweaks. [b]Please do not expect any content updates right after launch[/b]. I am considering making content updates in the future such as new levels or even things like Christmas updates that make everything snowy and may turn the regular fox soldiers into artic foxes!

[b]The moveset[/b]

Darksy's Adventure is a platformer which you may have figured out. During development a lot of thought went into Darksy's moveset. It may seem simple at first, he can mainly pounce, jump and do a tail whip. However you can combine these 3 moves in [b]many[/b] ways and reach areas and cross distances you may thought were impossible to reach. I hope that players will take their time to familiarize themselves with the controls to see what I'm talking about. 

[b]Level design[/b]

The early levels of Darksy's Adventure were designed with freedom in mind, they are free roaming levels where you can go wherever you want. You can also absolutely destroy these early levels and beat some of them in less than 3 minutes if you know the controls well. Luckily for new players, the early levels do not require any crazy tricks. Same can't be said about the later levels...
Each level was designed to be unique. To help this feeling I composed unique soundtrack for every level. If you want to hear a specific soundtrack you must go into that one level to hear it.

[b]100% completion[/b]

If you are one of the people that love to finish games with all achievements unlocked then this section is for you! To get all achievements you [b]must[/b] achieve a completion score of 100%. You can track your progress in the stats section, accessible from the main menu screen. Alternatively you can track it from the level select. In the level select in the top left corner of the screen you can see the level name and few icons below it. Here is what they mean:

[list]
[*] Cartridge icon: Tells you if you have collected a game cartridge in the level
[*] Purple star: Tells you if you have completed the level with all atoms collected
[*] Red star: Tells you if you have completed the level with all checkpoints skipped
[*] Yellow star: Tells you if you have completed the level without dying
[/list]

You don't have to do all of them at once. If, for example, you beat a level without dying and then die in it the next time, you will [b]not[/b] lose the rating.

[b]Game Difficulty[/b]

First of, I'd like to start with the difficulty. Having made the game basically myself, I was the only one who tested it for majority of the game's development. I felt that the difficulty was fine and I (naively) thought that I had done a good job. Handing the game to playtesters, I realized that I had not balanced the game as well as I had hoped. The game was way too difficult for some while not so for others. To hopefully address this issue I added a mechanic where the game will spawn extra lives if you're low on them, as well as 3 difficulty settings: easy, medium, hard. Launching the game for the first time, the medium difficulty is selected. On the steam page I didn't get into the specifics so I'd like to outline them here.

[u]Easy difficulty[/u]

[list]
[*] Enemies are less aggressive
[*] Extra platforms spawn to aid platforming
[/list]

Any atoms you collect will [b]not[/b] be saved

[u]Medium difficulty[/u]

[list]
[*] Enemies behave normally
[*] No extra platforms spawn
[/list]

[u]Hard difficulty[/u]

[list]
[*] Enemies are more aggressive
[*] No checkpoints spawn (meaning free checkpointless run)
[*] Some hazards are one hit kills
[*] No extra lives spawn
[/list]

While playing on the hard difficulty you gain extra atoms for completing levels

That being said, thank you very much for reading all of this (if you have) and I hope you enjoy Darksy's Adventure when it comes out!

-Honza 55 44
